endCondition.description: After round 7: eliminate players with negative money, deduct offspring from Popularity, score conservation projects, spend all money on construction, then compare

notes: family: min-of-tracks. Enter Popularity and Conservation after all end-of-game steps; the Animal Welfare project points (5/3, -2 below -1) are added to whichever value is currently lower and must be applied by the scorer beforehand. Victory points input is derived (enter 0 for it). Co-op/solo variants not modelled.
